title: Sardine tomato curry
summary: Sardine tomato curry is a indian dinner built around sardines in spring water and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Sardine tomato curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add sardines in spring water and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chopped tomatoes.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Sardine tomato curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Sardine tomato curry.
